candidates.statement: Inventory rejects configuration values (14 configuration_rejections, 7 ERROR configuration_value_rejected with status 503) and its deployment record shows configuration_valid=false at version 3.1.3, producing inventory checkout errors (1350ms ERROR span) and gateway call-inventory errors (1001ms ERROR).
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone does not establish causation; gateway and order metrics show low error rates, so blast radius is bounded to inventory path.

report.explanation: Inventory shows configuration rejections and 503 configuration_value_rejected errors with an invalid configuration revision, matching the bad-configuration taxonomy. Gateway traces show errors only on the inventory call path; order and gateway metrics remain healthy. Deployment record is corroborating but not causal by itself.
